tooltips.isDefault: If checked, this configuration will be the default for users in these teams who haven't selected a specific config.
tooltips.order: Controls the position of this configuration in the selector dropdown. Lower numbers appear first.
tooltips.isDisabled: If checked, this configuration will be hidden from the selector dropdown but the record will be preserved.
tooltips.isGloballyShared: If checked, this configuration will be available to all users regardless of team assignment. Only administrators can toggle this option.
tooltips.hideOnDropdown: If checked, this configuration will be active but hidden from the selector dropdown. Users can still be assigned to it via preferences.
